result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural tone ('we', 'journey', 'change the face of health care'). Health equity and governance lead, with governance stated as an absolute commitment ('committed... in everything we do, every day'). Employee culture gets one sentence. Customers, innovation and business description are mostly implied. Environment, safety and shareholders are absent.
